item.title: More child care options for families with new family day care services opening

item.title: Parents have called for a national perpetrator register. Here’s how providers might respond.
item.description: Last week, the Daniel Morcombe Foundation, parent advocates including campaigners Childcare Choice wrote to the Prime Minister calling for a national perpetrator register, a mechanism to ensure parents and providers are alerted to charged individuals and their childcare settings without the delays we have seen play out, again, in real cases.
